name: The Mechanical Elephant Caravan
description: A procession of elegant, brass-and-wood mechanical elephants, each uniquely decorated, moves gracefully through a misty, ancient forest at dawn.
prompt: A stunning and elegant steampunk scene of a caravan of five large, ornate mechanical elephants walking through a misty, ancient forest at dawn. Each elephant is uniquely designed: one is made of polished brass with gold accents, another of dark wood with silver inlays, a third of weathered iron with glowing blue gems. They move with surprising grace and quiet dignity. Their eyes glow softly—amber, sapphire, emerald. Tiny lanterns hang from their backs, casting warm light through the fog. In the background, ancient, moss-covered stone ruins peek through the trees. Sunlight filters through the canopy in shafts. The atmosphere is mysterious, majestic, and full of quiet power. Highly detailed digital painting with a focus on metal textures and atmospheric lighting.
caption: Gentle giants of brass and belief, carrying dreams through the mists of time. Where do their trunk-led trails go? 🐘🌫️
